title: Myocardial infarction and angina
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's coronary disease, angina or myocardial infarction.

labels.cad_unstable: Coronary artery disease with unstable angina
labels.cad_angina: Coronary artery disease with angina, type not stated

describe.nstemi_recent: Two weeks ago the patient had an NSTEMI (non-ST elevation myocardial infarction), treated medically; this is the follow-up visit, still within the 4 weeks of care for it.
describe.old_mi: The patient had a myocardial infarction (heart attack) 8 months ago that has healed; no current symptoms and no ongoing care for it.
describe.cad_unstable: The provider documents coronary artery disease of the native arteries with unstable angina (new rest pain this week); urgent cardiology review is arranged.
describe.cad_angina: The provider documents coronary artery disease of the native arteries with angina on exertion; the type of angina is not stated, and nitroglycerin is renewed.

acute_mi_coded_old.description: Coded old myocardial infarction (I25.2) within 4 weeks of the infarction.

old_mi_coded_acute.description: Coded an acute myocardial infarction (I21) more than 4 weeks after it, with no ongoing care.

missed_combination.description: Coded coronary disease and angina separately instead of the I25.11- combination code.

understated_angina.description: Coded unspecified angina when unstable angina is documented.

overstated_angina.description: Coded unstable angina when the type of angina is not documented.

rules.explain: An MI is coded as acute (I21) for 4 weeks (28 days) from onset, including follow-up visits: NSTEMI, I21.4 (HCC 228).

wrong.why: It is within 4 weeks: still I21.4.

rules.explain: An MI more than 4 weeks ago that needs no further care: old myocardial infarction, I25.2 (no HCC).

wrong.why: After 4 weeks with no ongoing care, the MI is old: I25.2.

rules.explain: Coronary artery disease with unstable angina has a combination code: I25.110 (HCC 229). Angina is not coded separately.

wrong.why: Use the combination code I25.110, not two codes.

rules.explain: Coronary artery disease with angina of unstated type: combination code I25.119 (no HCC in V28).

wrong.why: Use the combination code I25.119, not two codes.
